strings.name: Fernanda Torres
strings.summary: Raised in a theatrical family, Torres trained at Tablado and works across stage, film and television comedy. She won Cannes’ acting prize in 1986, expanded her Brazilian audience through Os Normais and solo theater, and wrote novels and columns. I’m Still Here brought a 2025 Golden Globe and international attention to family memory under dictatorship.
